_comment: Single source of truth. Feeds BOTH the private posting kit (tools/posting-kit) and the public answer pages (public/gaby/quiz/<slug>/). Run: npm run quiz:build. Every quiz needs: day, slug, situation, situationEn, place, question, options[], answer, why (may contain <b>/<i>), takeaway. The slug is the public URL and lives forever in social comments — never change one after posting, and never let it give the answer away.

quizzes.question: You are at the bar and want to ask what tapas they have. Which one is right?
quizzes.why: You are asking the bar, not one person — so it is tienen, the ustedes form. ¿Qué tapas tiene? is grammatical but it asks a single individual, which is not how you address staff behind a counter. And qué takes the accent in a question.
quizzes.takeaway: Addressing a business is almost always plural in Spain.

quizzes.question: You want the set lunch. You say “Sí, el del día, por favor.” What is missing?
quizzes.answer: menú — “Sí, el menú del día, por favor.”
quizzes.why: English lets you drop the noun once it is obvious. Spanish wants it in there: el menú del día is a fixed phrase, and leaving out menú makes el del día sound like you are pointing at something unnamed.
quizzes.takeaway: You will be understood without it. You will also sound like you are guessing.

quizzes.question: You want to ask if they know where the nearest health centre is. Saber or conocer?
options: ¿Conoce dónde está el centro de salud?
¿Sabe dónde está el centro de salud?
quizzes.answer: ¿Sabe dónde está el centro de salud?
quizzes.why: Saber is for facts and information — an address, a time, how to do something. Conocer is for being familiar with a person or a place. You want the fact, so it is sabe. You would use conocer in ¿Conoce este barrio?
